extracted.intended_audience: prospective and experienced generic drug developers, ANDA applicants, and regulatory professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and policy criteria for improving the development, submission, review, and approval of abbreviated new drug applications (ANDAs) and related generic drug activities. Covers bioequivalence, submission practices, facility readiness, labeling, fee assessment, and FDA procedural expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarify regulatory expectations for new and experienced drug developers
rubrics_metrics.description: By clarifying FDA’s regulatory expectations for new entrants and experienced drug developers alike, FDA is supporting prospective generic drug developers and improving the overall quality of ANDAs submitted to the Agency for approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective statement: improve quality of ANDAs by clarifying FDA expectations; no additional procedural detail on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain rigorous scientific standards while improving review efficiency and predictability
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA is implementing initiatives to enhance its own review process efficiency to improve the speed and predictability of the generic drug review process while maintaining our rigorous scientific standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level policy balancing speed/predictability with scientific rigor; directs users to specific guidances listed below for operational detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: M13A Bioequivalence for Immediate-Release Solid Oral Dosage Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: M13A Bioequivalence for Immediate-Release Solid Oral Dosage Forms (October 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance aligns with ICH; provides BE standards for IR solid oral dosage forms (refer to full guidance for specifics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of Drug Master Files in Advance of Certain ANDA Submissions under GDUFA
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Industry: Review of Drug Master Files in Advance of Certain ANDA Submissions under GDUFA (October 2024; also listed October 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes expectations and procedures for pre-review of DMFs relevant to ANDAs to streamline submissions and review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for Reconsideration at the Division Level Under GDUFA
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Industry: Requests for Reconsideration at the Division Level Under GDUFA (October 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets forth procedures and standards for submitting and evaluating division-level reconsideration requests under GDUFA timelines and processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: ANDA Submissions – Amendments and Requests for Final Approval to Tentatively Approved ANDAs
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: ANDA Submissions – Amendments and Requests for Final Approval to Tentatively Approved ANDAs (December 2025; earlier versions listed January 2024, September 2020, January 2019, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides requirements and expectations for amendments and how to request final approval of tentatively approved ANDAs; multiple revisions indicate evolving procedural/scoring details.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of Off-Patent, Off-Exclusivity Drugs without an Approved Generic
rubrics_metrics.description: List of Off-Patent, Off-Exclusivity Drugs without an Approved Generic (updated periodically; entries listed through June 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource identifying market opportunities for generic developers; implicitly a criterion for prioritizing development of generics for unmet off-patent products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Integrity for In Vivo Bioavailability and Bioequivalence Studies (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance: Data Integrity for In Vivo Bioavailability and Bioequivalence Studies (April 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses expectations for data integrity in BA/BE studies; implies standards for data collection, retention, and authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling and Retention of BA and BE Testing Samples (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: Handling and Retention of BA and BE Testing Samples (March 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations for sample handling and retention to support BA/BE claims and regulatory inspection/review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled Correspondence Related to Generic Drug Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Controlled Correspondence Related to Generic Drug Development (March 2024; also December 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when and how to use controlled correspondence to obtain FDA feedback during generic drug development; includes what questions are appropriate and what information to provide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revising ANDA Labeling Following Revision of the RLD Labeling Guidance for Industry
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Revising ANDA Labeling Following Revision of the RLD Labeling Guidance for Industry (January 2024; earlier draft January 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes procedures and expectations for updating ANDA labeling consistent with revisions to the reference listed drug (RLD) labeling guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Review of ANDAs (MAPP revision)
rubrics_metrics.description: MAPP Revision: Filing Review of ANDAs (October 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes internal FDA filing-review processes and criteria used to determine whether an ANDA is filed and accepted for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-Warning Letter Meetings Under GDUFA
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Industry: Post-Warning Letter Meetings Under GDUFA (September 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations and procedural guidance for meetings after issuance of warning letters under GDUFA-regulated activities; includes timing and content considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ANDA Suitability Petitions (MAPP revision)
rubrics_metrics.description: MAPP Revision: ANDA Suitability Petitions (September 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes FDA policy for evaluating suitability petitions that request to submit an ANDA instead of a 505(b)(2) or NDA and the criteria for acceptability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover Letter Attachments for Controlled Correspondences and ANDA Submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Industry: Cover Letter Attachments for Controlled Correspondences and ANDA Submissions (June 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides instruction on required and recommended attachments to cover letters to ensure submissions are processed correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment of Facility-Based Deficiency Major-to-Minor Reclassification Requests
rubrics_metrics.description: MAPP: Assessment of Facility-Based Deficiency Major-to-Minor Reclassification Requests (June 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains criteria and process for requesting and assessing reclassification of facility inspection deficiencies from major to minor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessing User Fees Under the Generic Drug User Fee Amendments of 2022
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Assessing User Fees Under the Generic Drug User Fee Amendments of 2022 (June 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how FDA assesses GDUFA user fees, including what triggers fees and how they are calculated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure to Respond to an ANDA Complete Response Letter Within the Regulatory Timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Industry: Failure to Respond to an ANDA Complete Response Letter Within the Regulatory Timeframe (December 2022; earlier draft September 2020).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes consequences and expectations when applicants fail to respond to a CRL within regulatory timeframes and how FDA handles such failures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Submission of Facility Information Related to Prioritized Generic Drug Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: ANDAs: Pre-Submission of Facility Information Related to Prioritized Generic Drug Applications (December 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what facility information should be pre-submitted for prioritized ANDAs and how it will be used in review prioritization and facility readiness assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Approval Supplements Under GDUFA for ANDA Submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: ANDA Submissions – Prior Approval Supplements Under GDUFA (October 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains criteria and procedural requirements for submitting prior approval supplements to ANDAs under GDUFA frameworks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Requests and Discipline Review Letters under GDUFA (MAPP 5220.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Information Requests and Discipline Review Letters under GDUFA, and accompanying MAPP 5220.5 (October 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes issuance, content, and responses to information requests and discipline review letters for ANDAs, including procedural timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility Readiness: Goal Date Decisions Under GDUFA
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Industry: Facility Readiness: Goal Date Decisions Under GDUFA (October 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how facility readiness affects GDUFA goal date decisions and what information sponsors should provide to support facility readiness determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitive Generic Therapies (final guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Competitive Generic Therapies (October 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines FDA’s policies for identifying and incentivizing competitive generic therapies, including criteria for qualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisions to Prioritization of Review of Original ANDAs, Amendments, and Supplements (MAPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revisions to the Prioritization of the Review of Original ANDAs, Amendments, and Supplements MAPP (October 2022 et al.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes criteria and policies FDA uses to prioritize review of ANDAs and related submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of Therapeutic Equivalence (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: Evaluation of Therapeutic Equivalence (July 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides criteria and procedures for evaluating therapeutic equivalence between generic products and reference products; relevant to BE, formulation and labeling considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good ANDA Submission Practices (final guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Good ANDA Submission Practices (January 2022; earlier drafts 2018, 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines expectations for content, organization, and completeness of ANDA submissions to avoid filing delays or deficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revising ANDA Labeling Following Revision of the RLD Labeling (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: Revising ANDA Labeling Following Revision of the RLD Labeling (January 2022 draft; later finalized January 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on when and how ANDA sponsors should revise labeling in response to changes in the reference listed drug labeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transdermal and Topical Delivery Systems – Product Development and Quality Considerations (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: Transdermal and Topical Delivery Systems – Product Development and Quality Considerations (November 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides development and quality criteria specific to transdermal/topical generics (formulation, testing, bioequivalence considerations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Harmonizing Compendial Standards with Drug Application Approval Using the USP Pending Monograph Process (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: Harmonizing Compendial Standards with Drug Application Approval Using the USP Pending Monograph Process (July 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses aligning compendial standards with approval decisions and use of USP pending monograph process for generics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using the Inactive Ingredient Database (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: Using the Inactive Ingredient Database (July 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how ANDA applicants can use the FDA inactive ingredient database to support formulation choices and justify excipient use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determining Whether to Submit an ANDA or a 505(b)(2) Application (final guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Guidance for Industry: Determining Whether to Submit an ANDA or a 505(b)(2) Application (May 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides decision criteria to help sponsors choose the appropriate regulatory pathway (ANDA vs. 505(b)(2)), including when reliance on published literature or differences from the RLD affect pathway.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program for Recognition of Voluntary Consensus Standards Related to Pharmaceutical Quality (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance for Industry: CDER’s Program for the Recognition of Voluntary Consensus Standards Related to Pharmaceutical Quality (February 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains criteria for recognition and use of voluntary consensus standards in pharmaceutical quality assessments for generics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addition of patent submission dates to the Orange Book
rubrics_metrics.description: Addition of patent submission dates to Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations – the “Orange Book” (November 2017).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational update to Orange Book entries to include patent submission dates where available; affects patent-related considerations for ANDA applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Submission Facility Correspondence for Prioritized Generic Drug Applications (draft/updates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Guidance: ANDAs: Pre-Submission of Facility Information Related to Prioritized Generic Drug Applications (November 2017; finalized Dec 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages early facility information submissions to support prioritization and readiness determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: FDA policy to issue product-specific or product-class specific guidance at least two years before first lawful ANDA submission for newly approved NCEs
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated Practice – FDA will issue product-specific or product-class specific guidance on how generic copies of newly approved, non-complex new chemical entity drugs can be developed, and make such guidance available at least two years prior to the first lawful ANDA submission date. (October 2017).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational commitment to provide developmental guidance and predictability to generic developers for newly approved NCEs.
